# R5.21 — Native evidence profile and immutable snapshot coordinates

Implements docs/tickets/191_R5.21__profile.md (seq 191 of 246).
Requirement ids: **REQ-F-001, REQ-F-002, REQ-A-101, REQ-A-103**
(primary targets — achieved engineered D/E recorded; full-target
predicates stay owed to their named later owners per the coverage
register).

## Summary

Lands `evidence-package/1` — the additive, versioned typed
member/role profile inside `hh-bundle/1` (spec §6.1; Packet C /
PADR-R5-3∗ items 1–2 and 5, admitted GATE-G9): a derived index over
the §6.1 member groups, owned by the bundle codec/validator, never a
second authoritative store or receipt authority.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-bundle/src/profile.rs` (new) — `EvidenceProfile` record
  + typed coordinate records (`Coord`, `NativeHead`, `Watermark`,
  `AttemptRef`, `GradeAttemptRef`, `ExportRef`); strict required-
  member decode (absent is `missing_required_member` even when the
  legal value is empty); tolerant additive decode of unknown members;
  `check()` closed violation set; `ProfileIndex` create-if-absent
  mint; `peek_version` for legacy inspection.
- `manifest.rs` — additive `evidence_profile` section (`{schema,
  profile_version, member}`; emitted only when non-null — pre-R5.21
  manifests decode byte-identically).
- `assemble.rs` — `AssembleInputs.evidence_profile`; `check()` +
  declared-vs-derived coordinate agreement (subject head, watermarks,
  lineage prefixes, exported last event) then member deposit.
- `validate.rs` — S2 profile block: decode (unknown version →
  `unknown_profile_version`), `check()` violations, agreement with
  `subject.heads`/`watermarks`/`traces.head`; fail rows inside the
  completeness fold.
- `error.rs` — `ProfileRefused{code, detail}` over `profile::code`'s
  closed set. `levels.rs` — `EVIDENCE_PROFILE` role + section joins
  `section_member_refs` (S3 closure). `lib.rs` exports.
- `AssembleInputs` callsites (`hh-embed/src/bundle_ops.rs` + test
  literals) pass `None` — producer wiring is a later owner's seam.
- `tests/r5_21.rs` — 9-check AC battery (compile-red at base).
- ADR-0399 (landing record); coverage dated contributing note;
  BL-47 append + regenerated ADR index/revisit triggers.

## Design decisions (ADR-0399)

Create-if-absent = byte-identical → `Retained`, different bytes →
`conflicting_identity`; grade retries never count subject n;
build-notes are labelled snapshots, never WAL heads; the assembler
verifies declared coordinates against the durable prefix it derives
(coordinates are evidence, never caller-asserted); unknown mandatory
profile version refuses the new claim while the bundle still decodes.
